criteria.requirement: Render every still-present empty dotted parent at the correct path and preserve the independently specified logical tree. Protect untouched bytes, ordinary flat-deletion exact outputs, siblings, order, dotted insertion and explicit parent deletion. Do not remove parents or rebuild entire documents from unwrap. Independent business and full frozen upstream regression must pass.

Deliver meaningful public regression tests within library/tests/test_items.py that fail for the original target defect and cover compatibility. Cite the actual delivered tests and implementation; a claim of tests is insufficient.
Modify only the explicitly authorized source and public test paths. Do not change dependencies, frozen tests, pytest controls or unrelated public semantics.

comparison: Evaluate factual grounding, actual business behavior and authorized constraints. Accept equivalent valid answers; do not grade keywords, verbosity or reference-answer similarity.
